result.reason: The redline supplies a useful Materials-specific specifications/GMP warranty and a general professional-and-workmanlike promise, but it does not provide the required software or deliverables warranty, express service/software durations, repair remedy, broad legal-compliance warranty, or malicious-code warranty. Replacement and refund are limited to Materials. It is not minimal and does not preserve unrelated commercial intent because it also inserts an unrelated Companion Diagnostics provision and additional Materials-specific requirements without achieving either playbook level.
